en:
Wh-What are we gonna do? No one said
anything about a time limit!

I-I know! You should kill yourself! You can
even make it look all glamorous and shit!

Wait a minute...
Are you here to kill me!?

N-No! If you kill me, you won't just piss off
my fans! You'll piss off all of humanity!

<CLT=cltMIND>I spent some time calming Miu while she
panicked due to her misunderstanding...
<CLT=cltMIND>Miu and I grew a little closer today.
